== Course of events ==

While making their way back toward the Emerald City, Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion lose their way amid wide fields of buttercups and daisies. The four travelers, on foot, find themselves unable to keep to a clear path through the flowers as they attempt to return to the Emerald City.

The group's disorientation in the fields comes at a point in their journey when reaching the Emerald City is their goal, and it is only afterward, once the Golden Cap's charm brings the Winged Monkeys to carry them the rest of the way, that the travelers finally complete their passage to the Emerald City. During that flight, the Monkey King recounts to them the tale of Gayelette and Quelala, tying the group's arrival to the deeper history behind the Winged Monkeys' service.
